## Projects

### Stilgar — Security Research for AI Agent Harnesses
- URL: https://usestilgar.com/
- Problem: AI agent harnesses and teams lack security tooling built for their unique trust boundaries.
- Solution: A security research initiative building tools to make agent orchestration safer and more reliable at the infrastructure level.

### Inconnu — Zero-Trust Bridge for RAG
- URL: https://inconnu.ai/
- Problem: RAG systems access sensitive data without proper security boundaries.
- Solution: Zero-trust security layer between RAG pipelines and data sources.

### Harness — Quality Guardrails for AI Coding Agents
- URL: https://github.com/0xjgv/harness
- Problem: AI coding agents generate code without consistent structure or quality standards.
- Solution: Opinionated project templates with built-in guardrails so agents produce reliable, maintainable code from the start.

### Spok — Spec-Driven Development for AI Coding Agents
- URL: https://github.com/0xjgv/spok
- Problem: AI coding agents build without first agreeing on what to ship.
- Solution: A lightweight spec-driven workflow — explore, propose a chunked change, apply one slice at a time, then fold the result back into living specs.
- Inspiration: Dexter Horthy's talk "Everything We Got Wrong About Research-Plan-Implement" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YwZR6tc7qYg)

### Interlocks — Deterministic Python Quality Loop
- URL: https://github.com/0xjgv/interlocks
- Problem: Local checks, CI, and agent-authored pull requests drift apart.
- Solution: One deterministic Python quality loop — lint, typecheck, test, coverage, and more — behind a single command so humans and agents review against the same output.

### Wando — Security Checklist for Teams
- URL: https://wando.vercel.app/
- Problem: Teams lack actionable security guidance.
- Solution: Curated, practical security and privacy recommendations teams can actually follow.
